## Rules

- Show the real thing: screenshot, short screen recording, the architecture diagram from `architecture/TECH-STACK.md`.
- No customer names, phone numbers, keys, internal URLs or admin screens in any image. Use demo data.
- Say what you built and what you learned. Do not claim scale you do not have.
- If a client owns the product, get their OK before posting.

## Thread for X (draft, one idea per post)

3. Installable app (PWA / TWA): one diagram or screenshot and one sentence on how it works.

## Turning a diagram into an image

Paste a Mermaid block into https://mermaid.live and export PNG or SVG, or run `npx @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli -i in.mmd -o out.png`. Check the image has no private data before posting.
